last_episode_to_air.name: Jurassic World
last_episode_to_air.overview: The grand final. Three teams tackle a giant LEGO island shaped like the Jurassic Park logo, each bringing a different era of the franchise to life. The winner takes home $100,000.

name: LEGO Masters
overview: Eight pairs of Brick heads are pitted against each other in a quest to impress with their creativity, design and flair, driven by their unparalleled passion for the possibilities that will start with a single LEGO brick.

seasons.name: Grand Masters
seasons.overview: Australia's favourite family show ﻿LEGO® Masters is back for a fifth season in 2023 – but this time, with a huge twist. In a world first, the winners and top teams from previous seasons plus a new wildcard duo will face off to determine the best of the best in LEGO Masters Grand Masters.

seasons.name: Australia vs The World
seasons.overview: In our Olympic year, Season 6 will be "Australia vs The World" with four brand new Australian teams taking on the four best LEGO® teams who have previously competed in their homelands.

seasons.name: Grand Masters of the Galaxy
seasons.overview: This year the series is 'Grand Masters of the Galaxy', with teams from Australia competing against duos from USA, Sweden, Finland, Canada, China and New Zealand to see who can claim the title of the greatest LEGO builders in the Milky Way.

seasons.name: Bricktacular
seasons.overview:
Lego Masters returns for its eighth season with a Bricktacular and jaw-dropping twist: for the very first time, fan-favourite brick builders from Australia and across the world battle it out in teams of three.

Across the four episodes, this special event will feature four of the most powerful entertainment worlds of all time – The Lord of the Rings, DC Heroes, Bluey and Jurassic World and $100,000 on the line for the team crowned the world’s greatest LEGO Masters.
